gate_results.rationale: All evaluated IT criteria for the opportunity phase are satisfied based on REVIEW_FACTS_IT. The catalog status is standard, no duplicate enterprise capability exists, licensing is compliant, and technology lifecycle is well above the 12-month EOL threshold (60 months). Phase-dependent checks (CMDB record, run owner assignment, capacity headroom, and ITSM change approval) apply only to later phases.

Evaluation of REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE confirms that ip_overlap is false, api_gateway_present is true, data_owner_present is true, measured_latency_ms (55) does not exceed latency_target_ms (500), and multi_az is true (satisfying the HA requirement for Critical business criticality). However, reversibility_status is 'missing', triggering finding ARCH-REV-001 ('Reversibility design is incomplete') with action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE and disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS. The finding permits risk acceptance, and standing authorization mandate MANDATE-d3d68264-320d-50e7-bcd1-79409c4b2f8d-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 was exercised to approve with conditions.

Evaluation of REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY reveals 2 open critical vulnerabilities ('critical_vulns_open': 2), verified by VULN_SCAN. Under the normative decision policy, open critical vulnerabilities trigger finding SEC-VULN-001 with required action REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES and disposition NO_GO. Risk acceptance is not permitted for this finding, yielding a final gate disposition of NO_GO.

Technical readiness evaluation of REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS identified five gating issues: (1) no successful restore test has been executed ('restore_tested': false), triggering TR-RESTORE-001; (2) measured data loss of 84 minutes exceeds the committed RPO of 60 minutes ('measured_data_loss_minutes': 84), triggering TR-RPO-001; (3) load testing reached only 50% of peak load ('load_test_pct_of_peak': 50), triggering TR-LOAD-001; (4) 1 critical static-analysis finding remains open in CI ('critical_static_findings': 1), triggering TR-CODE-001; and (5) 3 production blockers remain open ('open_blockers': 3), triggering TR-BLOCKER-001. All findings require REWORK, resulting in an overall gate disposition of REWORK.

Evaluation of REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL indicates weak strategic alignment ('strategic_alignment': 'weak'), triggering finding GEN-STRAT-001 with action OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION (disposition SUSPENSION). Additionally, review of UPSTREAM_DECISIONS shows that upstream gate BUILD-03-SECURITY-1 returned a NO_GO disposition, triggering finding GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO ('1 upstream gate(s) returned NO_GO.') with action RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO (disposition NO_GO). Under the governance decision policy, NO_GO has the highest priority and cannot be risk-accepted, yielding a final gate disposition of NO_GO.
